name: Hasilpur

requestOutcomes.outcome: Official PULSE viewer HTML retrieved over TLS; current JavaScript identified the public /api/gis/token route and ArcGIS service configuration.
Public map-session token returned by the viewer's own route; used only for the public ArcGIS map service and not retained in packet artifacts.
Service metadata returned Punjab district layers including Bahawalpur; initial tokenless request returned ArcGIS 499 Token Required.
Bahawalpur Feature Layer metadata returned polygon geometry, source WKID 102100/latestWkid 3857, maxRecordCount 2000, GeoJSON support, and fields including unique OBJECTID.

Bounded anonymous exact-point query with inSR=4326, spatialRelIntersects, safe outFields OBJECTID/Khasra_ID/Khewat_ID/Label, returnGeometry=true, outSR=4326, resultRecordCount=3, and f=geojson returned one polygon with OBJECTID 857666.
Official Bahawalpur district administration land-revenue/land-record administration context; general custodian evidence, not a parcel feature endpoint.
Official Punjab local-government page identifies Tehsil Council Hasilpur; local administrative context, not a parcel feature endpoint.
Official Punjab PMU page lists Hasilpur land-use classification and map resources; planning/map context, not a parcel feature endpoint.
Official Punjab Land Records Authority service identity and land-record custodian evidence; no ownership or unsafe record fields requested.

nativeFieldMapping.OBJECTID: stable native OID retained as id
nativeFieldMapping.Label: observed but not retained

schemaAndCrs.compositeKeyProvenance: None; OBJECTID is the service-declared unique OID.
schemaAndCrs.inspection: Direct service metadata and bounded safe-field exact-point response were inspected. One native-ID polygon was retained in the sample GeoJSON.

qualification.reason: A real first-party parcel response is evidenced, but one exact-point polygon does not prove citywide coverage or qualify a runtime adapter; independent serial review remains required.

scopeLimits: No citywide extent or completeness claim is made.
The exact WUP coordinate was used unchanged; a hit is not extrapolated to all of Hasilpur.
Only one polygon is retained and no raw source attribute set is retained.
No credentials, private tokens, unsafe fields, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or TLS exception were used.
Packet completion records research only; it is not source integration or runtime admission.
uncertainty: The PULSE viewer's public configuration and Bahawalpur cadastral layer are current and inspectable. Hasilpur-specific city boundary coverage and stable adapter contract beyond OBJECTID/geometry remain unresolved.
